semiconductor_relevance: High — Creative Technology Corporation specializes in manufacturing electrostatic chucks and related systems critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Creative Technology Corporation is a leading manufacturer of electrostatic chucks, heaters, and sensors for the semiconductor industry. With over 20 years of experience, they supply advanced chucking systems for various applications including etching, CVD, and PVD, catering to device makers globally.
capabilities: Capacitance sensor technology for chucking systems
Particle control products including eraser disks and particle collectors
